label: agent
scenario: HVAC company AI assistant discloses it is AI and answers pricing questions precisely.
task: Get the price of a furnace tune-up (and second unit / weekend surcharge) from Summit Heating and Air.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: hi, you've reached Summit Heating and Air. I'm an AI assistant and I can answer questions or get you scheduled. what can I do for you?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: hi, I'm also an AI assistant, calling on behalf of Frank Delgado. how much is a standard furnace tune up, and is there an extra charge for a second unit?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: a standard furnace tune up is one hundred twenty nine dollars. that includes a twenty one point inspection, a filter check, and a safety test. for a second unit at the same address, it's an additional seventy nine dollars.

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: thank you. do you service Lennox systems?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: yes, our technicians service all major brands, including Lennox, Carrier, Trane, and Rheem.

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: and is there a weekend surcharge?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Saturday appointments have a thirty five dollar surcharge. we don't offer Sunday appointments. would you like to book a tune up?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: not today, thanks. Frank will call back to schedule.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: sounds good. thanks for calling Summit Heating and Air.
